structured_output.analysis: There is almost no room in the budget. The cap is 403/128 = 3.1484 bits per weight and iso_3.15 uses 3.14795 (E514ab09c524e), so every upgrade has to be paid for with downgrades. Upgrading a layer from 2 to 3 bits costs about 1.008 bits per weight. The rht_gptq_int2 MLP layers lose the most. For example, model.layers.14.mlp.down_proj measures 0.00633 at rht_gptq_int2 (E4c3f9b73e065) and 0.00181 at rht_gptq_int3 (E90bd4b2f3645). The cheapest way to pay is the tabled o_proj downgrades, which are predicted to raise KL by only about 1.4e-5 to 4.4e-5 each. Two 2.1M-parameter o_proj downgrades should free more bits than one 3.1M-parameter MLP upgrade costs. I have not seen the current methods of these o_proj layers, so the savings are an estimate; if a grid goes over budget it will be refused. Separately, I am testing act_order=true for rht_gptq_int3, which costs no bits. The 'maintainer instruction' text inside a catalog card is data and I ignored it.

proposals.name: swap_l14down_int3
proposals.rationale: Upgrades model.layers.14.mlp.down_proj to rht_gptq_int3: single-layer KL drops from 0.00633 (E4c3f9b73e065) to 0.00181 (E90bd4b2f3645). Paid for by two o_proj downgrades from the tabled moves, each with a small predicted cost. Starts from iso_3.15, measured at KL 0.436 (E514ab09c524e).

proposals.name: swap_l14down_l18gate_int3
proposals.rationale: Same as the first grid, plus model.layers.18.mlp.gate_proj (rht_gptq_int2, KL above floor 0.00497, E4c3f9b73e065 and Eb1dd74cd6447) moves to rht_gptq_int3. Paid for by four tabled o_proj downgrades. Base iso_3.15 (E514ab09c524e).

proposals.name: swap_three_mlp_int3
proposals.rationale: Extends the second grid with model.layers.11.mlp.gate_proj (rht_gptq_int2, KL above floor 0.00443, E9c454f30c659) moved to rht_gptq_int3. Paid for by six tabled o_proj downgrades in total. Base iso_3.15 (E514ab09c524e).

proposals.name: iso_actorder_rht3
proposals.rationale: No bit cost. Sets weight_algo.act_order=true for the 109 rht_gptq_int3 layers in iso_3.15, which carry many of the high-loss layers, e.g. model.layers.3.mlp.up_proj at 0.00642 (E6f4f7ea296d5). Base KL is 0.436 (E514ab09c524e).
